title: DOC Stat Hero
description: One real number at poster size, an eyebrow above and a line that explains it
useWhen: DOC has one sourced figure that carries the message ("$80,000", "36 modules").
notWhen: there is no real number (never invent one: use `DOC Claim Bar`).
guidance: stat: the figure as it should read ("$80,000", "189 lessons"). Only a real, sourced number; a short non-numeric stat ("Day one") is fine when there is none. Keep it short: it is set at poster size on one line.
kicker: what the number is, in a few words ("The gap nobody budgets for"). Optional.
body: one or two lines that explain the number.
Copy in US English, in the DOC voice: plain, specific, second person, no exclamation marks. Never invent a figure, price, date, module count, quote or name.

Themes: Foundations, Startup and Acquisition are the three tracks (red, purple, green grounds): use the one the piece is about, never mix tracks. Dark and Light are neutral, for the collective as a whole.

cta: no full stop. By theme: Foundations "Join the waitlist" (Foundations only), Startup "Enroll now", Acquisition "Register now", Dark "Apply today", Light "Get started" — unless the brief gives its own action.
